summary: Shelby County steel lookout run by the Texas Forest Service; a 1958 survey describes a tower about 120 feet tall. Listed as gone.

facts.design: Four-legged steel tower with a glass-enclosed cab, painted grey
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source describes the site now.

events.note: Survey station description of the standing tower; construction date not found

evidence.supports: listed as gone, Shelby County, coordinates
Shelby County, agency Texas Forest Service

evidence.quote: GLASS ENCLOSED CAB ON TOP, PAINTED GREY.
OF THE TOWER IS APPROXIMATELY 120 FEET.

evidence.supports: described by Coast and Geodetic Survey in 1958
evidence.quote: DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1958

notes_for_editor: Height: the NGS transcription gives an overall height of about 120 ft (converted to 36.6 m); it does not give cab-floor height, so height_m may be high for the guide's definition. The NGS record itself was not fetched; the description is read from the Forest Lookouts transcription. Construction date, staffing, fire history and site condition not found. The 2025 Cavallerano book (Texas A&M University Press) may cover this tower; a Duke University Press review of it returned HTTP 403 and the book was not read.
